Chiara: Tommaso's wife (married 17 Feb 2024), works at a pharmacy, drives a Yaris; her parents Giovanna and Franco live in Modena
Pietro: son, plays football (coach Paolo Bonacini since March 2034); Anna: daughter, dance school, 23 kg
Rosa: Tommaso's mother (garage in via Saragozza, rented out from April 2034); Elisa: sister in Ferrara, husband Nicola
Marco (Marco Bellini, with Serena): friend, five-a-side team; Simone: team organiser, bought the Punto; Davide: teammate
Giulia, Andrea, Stefano: high-school friends (group 'Amici del liceo'); Owen: English-speaking friend; Gianni: third-floor neighbour

Professionals: dott. Zaccaria (doctor, back pain), dott.ssa Fabbri (dentist), dott. Melandri (ophthalmologist), Sandro (plumber), Gualandi (accountant), Ferri (building administrator), maestra Gentili (Pietro's teacher), officina Bertolini (garage)
Runs at the Giardini Margherita, one run a week adding a km; reads novels, sometimes in English
